final_candidate: Not selected or bound by this scope. Complete and review final combined runtime/interface/default integration, commit all evaluators and comparator registration, then create the source/evaluator binding before decoding any fresh metadata. No binding is generated by importing this code or running artificial fixtures.

selection.algorithm: Within each type, SHA256(prefix + original ID) ascending, then original ID for stable ties; concatenate bridge selections then comparison selections. Decode only id and type. Reject duplicate/invalid IDs, unexpected types, or insufficient eligible populations.
selection.additional_exclusions: The pre-selection binding explicitly records every additional previously inspected ID, including an explicit empty list when none are declared. No fresh IDs or content have been inspected for this scope.
selection.content_boundary: Commit the source/evaluator/comparator binding remotely before metadata selection. Commit the selected ID/type manifest before decoding any question, answer, passage or annotation. Decode only the selected IDs to create a second source-free data binding and commit it before retrieval.

native.query_order: random.Random(61512 + configuration_index) applied to the frozen concatenated selected-ID order; identical across all five workers.
native.quality: Only final-off-first versus final-on-first. The two repeats verify identical complete payloads and cost, never add independent quality samples. Baseline and both final OFF complete native payloads must match excluding latency_ms only; both ON repetitions must reproduce complete payloads including shipping title-reference provenance.

quality_gates.paired_test: Exact two-sided McNemar/binomial discordance test: min(1, 2 * sum(C(gain+loss,k), k=0..min(gain,loss)) / 2**(gain+loss)); no-discordance p=1. Compare alpha exactly as integers.
quality_gates.introduced_displaced: Actual returned page IDs only, micro annotation-hit ratios. Primary introduced denominator must be positive; require introduced hit rate >= displaced hit rate when displaced denominator is positive. Zero displaced denominator is null with no relative comparison.
quality_gates.integrity: Zero source/projection/scope/budget/cache/identity errors and exact default/repeat payload equality. Original quality metric helpers are reused unchanged.

cost_gates.pooling: For EACH tokenizer/budget cell independently pool two final OFF repetitions and two final ON repetitions: 1024 latency samples per mode per cell. Never pool across configurations or include the v032 parity worker in cost comparisons. Retain first/repeat partitions.
cost_gates.combination: Each metric in each cell must satisfy BOTH limits. Native call timing includes real shipping provenance and ends before offline token/annotation/diagnostic evaluation.

resources.boundary: No per-call sampler/profiler/frame/full-pool tracing. Record Linux worker RSS/HWM snapshots before/after runtime import, source ingestion, prewarmed tokenizer/scoring preparation, native query phase and finalization; record process CPU usage and phase wall durations separately. Worker memory includes evaluator/corpus/reference tokenizers; snapshots and process high-water marks are not exhaustive peak attribution. Preserve private DB storage counts separately from public ledgers.
resources.host: One Linux host/boot, exact Python/SQLite and bound dependency versions; sequential fresh worker processes with no concurrent benchmark. The complete same-boot prefix may advance only to a never-started worker.
resources.release_boundary: This fresh quality/cost check does not replace any of the original 14-cell default performance/resource gates.

publication.controller: Local execution with explicit externally published Git checkpoints, independently checked by immutable commit plus current remote ref; no modification or bypass of existing hosted-only formal runners.
publication.selection_and_data: The binding, selected manifest and data binding are separate remotely verified commits before their next stage.
publication.workers: Create one exclusive worker intent and private random launch ticket, publish the intent plus complete prior prefix, then consume that local ticket once before any runtime setup/retrieval. A missing/consumed ticket, started state, partial output or partial ledger forbids replay. Ticket contents never enter Git. Publish every completed worker report and losslessly compressed original started/finished ledger before creating the next intent.
publication.failure: Keep every failed or interrupted report/ledger and remote intent; never delete, replay, replace or silently repair a started worker. Every source, evaluator, metric, configuration, schedule and selection identity is already frozen before metadata-only selection. No change is permitted after selection. If any fresh question/content/label is decoded, changing any frozen identity consumes that selected cohort as development and requires a separately registered unseen holdout; this applies even before the first scored call. A started worker is never retried for an operational failure.

comparators.required_before_selection: A separate committed comparator registration must freeze evaluator files, modes, shared-page/token limits, first-pass/read/transport boundaries, repetitions/order, dependencies/assets and these exact upstream pins before this selector can execute. This native script does not download/build/execute competitors.

pins.mode: upstream default hybrid BM25 plus fuzzy component
native hybrid local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and native reads; report lexical mode separately if bound

comparators.same_cohort: All comparisons use this exact 512-ID manifest and the same supplied canonical pages. Never splice new T1 scores into old256 competitor tables.
comparators.reuse: Existing adapter classes, component_hits, shared_response, pack_whole_blocks and pure cost helpers are reusable. Existing round4 registration/loader/controller cannot be rebound: they lock v031, old256, Q2 modes and their original execution claims.
comparators.dependencies: claude-mem: locked 15.18.1 source and Bun1.3.13; billion-context: locked source and Node24+ TypeScript erasure; ai-memory: locked v3.4.5 Linux x86_64 binary plus exact local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 files. Do not substitute an FTS fallback for missing hybrid assets.

reused_evaluator.contract: Reuse scoring, every-page annotation precision, shipping provenance and native metadata diagnostics as pure helpers. Do not invoke or modify its old-data binding/schedule/controller.

artificial_tests: Invented IDs and fabricated source-free score rows only: stratification/exclusions/stable selection, metadata column boundary, changed pins, exact discordance arithmetic, first-pair-only quality, actual introduced/displaced pages, per-cell pooled p50/p95 conjunction, parity/repeat mismatch, and incomplete/consumed-intent recovery. No fresh metadata/content/retrieval is read by tests.
interpretation: Native evidence delivery is not generated-answer accuracy. Passing this native gate alone is neither external-repository superiority nor release acceptance; the same-cohort comparison and all original default/compatibility/release requirements remain.

final_interface.required_before_selection: The final combined native runtime and its explicit CLI/MCP option must be integrated before freeze. A prospective certificate must verify that the only tool-schema extension is the approved optional strict boolean and exact description suffix, preserving instructions and actual initialization cost differences. This certificate and every listed evaluator file are committed and hash-bound before metadata selection; the unchanged original numeric fourteen-cell performance/resource gates remain required.
final_interface.verification: scripts.round5_interface_certificate.load_certificate(expected_sources) validates exact committed certificate bytes, source identities, source-free schema projection, generator registration and zero retrieval calls. Native bind/load_binding call it with the identical baseline/final candidate sources.
